title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Rajeshwari's humiliation deeply hurts Kanmani, prompting her to lash out at Anbu. Later, Anbu admires Kanmani as she peacefully sleeps despite her anger towards him.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Nalini and Ilamathi doubt Kalamma's kindness after Ganthimathi cooks for Paraman. Later, Kaippulla and Vandu advise Paraman to move forward and live happily with Ilamathi.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Vetri defends Abinaya over a billing mistake, but she tells him to stay away. After losing her job, a bitter Abinaya blames Vetri, while Shanmugam comforts her.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Poongodi's confession clears Mayandi and Meenatchi, leading to their release. Manjamalai is furious with her, while Pechi refuses to return home with him.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
episodeTitle: Malar, Mathi Push for Healthy Meals
description: Lakshmi worries after her BP and sugar levels rise, but Raghavan shows no concern. Malar and Mathi suggest inviting a dietitian home to guide the family on a healthier diet.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Anjali avoids Saravanan for her dad. While Meena tells Pandian that Thangamayil left home, leaving Pandian, Gomathi, and Raji sad about Bhagyam's act.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Rajbeer blocks Chandayatha's family from leaving Bihar for her wedding with Cheran. Pandian is upset when Aravind reveals his lunch outing with Vannathi.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
episodeTitle: Rohini Moves On from Her Marriage
description: Rohini signs the divorce papers with a heavy heart in the presence of the lawyer and Manoj's family. Vijaya objects to providing Rohini with income support after the divorce.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Aishwarya panics as Eshwari threatens to expose her to Rajanagam if she refuses her demands. She spots Sethupathi's tender file in the room while he is away.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Pooja firmly demands an apology from Aadhavan's grandmother for falsely accusing her of stealing the handbag. Later, he charms the angry Pooja with his loving antics.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: With Kandhasamy's approval for the QR code, the bank manager enables UPI facilities at Lakshmi Mess. Murugan then places digital banners around the premises to inform customers.

title: Bigg Boss The Common Man
episodeTitle: The Common Man: Contestants Assign Titles
description: After a glamorous ramp walk, contestants assign bold titles to each other.  A surprise entry stuns everyone, while the eviction results sweep the contestants off their feet.
